newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DORTMUND BEAT BUCHAREST, AWAIT AUXERRE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DORTMUND BEAT BUCHAREST, AWAIT AUXERRE.

text.p: German champions Borussia Dortmund coasted to an entertaining 5-3 win over Steaua Bucharest of Romania on Wednesday in their final group B match in the European Champions' League.
Dortmund were already assured of a place in the European Cup quarter-finals, where they will meet Auxerre of France.
Stephane Chapuisat put Dortmund ahead with a spectacular 13th minute free kick and added a second goal after the Romanians equalised from the penalty spot through Sabin Ilie.

Midfielder Rene Tretschok struck just before the break to make it 3-1 but Marius Baciu put Steaua back in touch in the 52nd minute. Karlheinz Riedle and Michael Zorc took Dortmund's tally to five in the 62nd and 64th minutes respectively.
Steaua striker Aurel Calin scored a spectacular long-range effort in the 79th minute.
"It wasn't an easy game because Steaua never gave up," Dortmund coach Ottmar Hitzfeld said.
"We wanted to give the fans something good to watch and that meant not being so tight at the back. It was a typical game where one team has already qualified."
Dortmund goalkeeper Stefan Klos added: "It was a good game for the spectators but not such a good one for the goalkeepers."
Dortmund will be hoping their quarter-final with Auxerre ends in the same way as their last battle with the French side -- in the 1993 UEFA Cup semifinals.
Dortmund won through on penalties, thanks to a brilliant save from Klos.

Borussia - 1-Stefan Klos, 2-Knut Reinhardt, 6-Matthias Sammer, 8-Michael Zorc, 9-Stephane Chapuisat, 13-Karlheinz Riedle (28-Ibrahim Tanko 64), 14-Paul Lambert, 15-Juergen Kohler, 16-Martin Kree, 17-Joerg Heinrich (25-Steinar Pedersen 68), 23-Rene Tretschok.
